title: Files and review
blurb: Walk a project in the rail, open a file, and review its change.

greet: Hi. Let us read a project and its change, like a reviewer.
Files on the left, the diff in the middle. Let us look.
finish: You walked the files and left a note. Good review.

steps.title: Go to the project
steps.note: A small Go project. It has a change in it.
steps.hint: Type cd projects/hello and press enter.

steps.title: Open the rail
steps.note: The files section lists the folder of this pane.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then b. The rail opens on the right.

steps.title: Give the rail the keys
steps.note: ctrl+b e moves the keyboard into the rail. The same keys bring it back.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then e. The badge says SIDEBAR.

steps.title: Walk to greet.go
steps.note: j moves down and k moves up. The lit row is the cursor.
steps.hint: Press j until greet.go is lit. ctrl+b f finds a file by name.

steps.title: Open the file
steps.note: Here enter opens it in a viewer. On your machine, enter copies the path and shift+enter opens your editor.
steps.hint: With greet.go lit, press enter. q closes the viewer.

steps.title: Review the change
steps.note: ctrl+b v shows what changed in the repository of this pane.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then v. The review fills the screen.

steps.title: Jump to the next hunk
steps.note: A hunk is one block of changed lines. ] goes to the next hunk, [ to the one before. } and { go by file.
steps.hint: Press ]. The cursor moves to the next block of changes.

steps.title: Leave a note
steps.note: c writes a note on the line under the cursor. enter saves it.
steps.hint: Press c, type a few words, then press enter.

steps.title: Send your notes
steps.note: On your machine, S sends the notes to the agent in this pane. esc closes the review.
steps.hint: Press S, shift and s. The dock says what happens.
